study: Source-only local envelope correspondence reliability before a recognition intervention
scope: All data read are from the original outer-fold1 training users; no held/validation signal used. Labels only stratify sampling, never fit matching.
input: abs(scipy.signal.hilbert(real clutterremoved RF, axis=range)); float64; no temporal mean subtraction or learned normalization
arms: t to t+1 versus t to (t+31)%90 in same record/view; distant control is not physical ground truth or pure causal intervention
reliability: Both forward and reverse centered patch cosine >=0.8, best-runner-up >=0.01; return residual <=1 bin; neither optimum at +/-6 endpoint; source patch centered norm >=.1*sqrt(17)*frame std. Zero-texture invalid; ties rejected by gap. Forward shift>0 means higher target range bin.
aggregation: Reliable/moving counts divided by eligible patch count within clip, zero eligible yields0; then equal-clip mean within user/view. Moving additionally requires nonzero integer forward shift. Not physical velocity.
gate_rationale: Require at least20% usable texture patches,10pp excess over temporal-distance control,5% nontrivial shifts in4/6 users of2/3 radars; engineering feasibility thresholds fixed before real-signal inspection, not statistical significance.
cost: After registration, process first two selected source records only to estimate full extraction with100% margin; do not inspect quality metrics in timing output. No parameter changes after timing.
if_pass: Supports only a future frozen recognition comparison with signed/unsigned/zero-shift controls and strong CNN; not a novel method, measured hand trajectory, or classification success.
if_fail: Stop this local-envelope matching configuration; no patch/lag/confidence threshold grid or neural branch justified by this screen.
persistence: Source IDs, forward/reverse cost volumes, shifts, masks, per-user/view statistics, raw/source/protocol/code hashes, software, timing and audit.
limitations: Eight users already researched, source diagnosis exploratory
RF envelope changes from multiple scatterers and interference need not be transport
Integer bins and limited search miss sub-bin/fast motion
Forward-backward agreement is internal consistency, not independent truth
Does not repeat failed global centroid/spread ordering test; still no innovation from combining known matching and consistency
